old: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki proposed on November 22, 2026 that frontier AI developers adopt binding limits tied to pretraining perplexity thresholds until monitoring tools meet concrete safety milestones.[^1]
new: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki proposed on November 22, 2026 that frontier AI developers adopt common limits tied to pretraining perplexity thresholds until monitoring tools meet concrete safety milestones.[^1]
why: Pachocki's essay proposes "common limits" that developers commit not to cross rather than legally binding limits.

support.quote: I further propose common limits, based on perplexity and other measurements, that developers are committed to not crossing
